title: Sunday · the board, before the sticker
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: The garage corkboard in November, twenty-two years of it, the week before one sticker joins it upside down: the Sunday inventories the board so the reader can find the change.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the corkboard, whole, filling the tier: the 1998 flyer, the yearbook photo at the bottom corner, the schedule and program and card, the walk map, the Florence page, the strangers' drawings, the shims' letters gone from it, twenty-two years of pins.

image.prompt: a large corkboard filling the frame crowded with twenty years of pinned papers, flyers, photos, a hand-drawn map, newspaper pages and drawings, no words legible
image.notes: The inventory in objects.md. The sticker arrives dw_2019-11-22, below the yearbook photo.

panels.name: Board

panels.composition: Tier 2: the bottom corner: the yearbook photo, and below it, empty cork. Room for one small thing.

image.prompt: the bottom corner of a corkboard with a small old yearbook photo pinned and a patch of bare cork beneath it, no words

panels.name: Corner

panels.composition: Tier 3: the board at night in the lamp's light, the man's shadow across it. Held.

image.prompt: a crowded corkboard at night in lamplight with a man's shadow falling across it, no words

panels.name: Lamp

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk

notes: The board inventoried. Room for one small thing.
